_idef0: Control for F.2.6 Explain Results and Limitations. Owner: F.3 Review Environmental Screening Evidence (C.3 Government Agencies).
disclaimer: Preliminary ecological screening only. This result is not a regulatory determination under any state or federal law and does not replace field surveys or agency review.
limitations: Threat weights, reach distances, habitat suitability and sensitivity are prototype values; ecologists still need to calibrate them.
Species records come from public observations and are incomplete for rare or rarely surveyed species.
Each result describes a whole 1 km × 1 km grid cell; conditions can differ within a parcel.
